'''Kybucks''' were [[ungulate]]s native to the [[Woolwarricca]] prairies of [[Kashyyyk/Legends|Kashyyyk]],<ref name="DB" /> and similar in appearance to the [[Tauntaun/Legends|tauntauns]] of [[Hoth/Legends|Hoth]].<ref name="Star Wars: Clone Wars DVD commentary">[[Star Wars: Clone Wars Volume Two|''Star Wars: Clone Wars'' Volume Two]] commentary</ref>

Their swift speed, along with the cover of their natural environment, allowed them to be able to run from predators. Kybucks could run at up to 90 [[Kilometer/Legends|kilometers]] per [[Standard hour/Legends|hour]]. [[Gender/Legends|Males]] had short horns sitting atop their head. There were many different breeds of kybucks, often identifiable by relative size and form of their horns.<ref name="DB" />

Kybucks [[Reproduction/Legends|mated]] for life. They raised an annual litter of two or three foals in rearing grounds protected by a barb thicket. Kybucks tended to flee from enemies when alone, but if a foe threatened a kybuck's offspring, the parents would fight to defend them. Kybucks attacked using leaping kicks and horned head-butts to fight off enemies.<ref name="DB" /> Judging by the way Yoda spoke to his kybuck, these creatures appeared to be quite intelligent.

The [[Wookiee/Legends|Wookiees]] of Woolwarrica adored the kybuck for having protective familial instincts that resembled that of the Wookiee culture. The Wookiees did not hunt the creatures. Some chieftains often domesticated kybucks as a symbol of status.<ref name="DB" />

[[File:Kybuck-TCWCG.jpg|thumb|left|180px|A tamed Kybuck mount]]
[[Grand Master/Legends|Grand Master]] [[Yoda/Legends|Yoda]] of the [[Jedi Order/Legends|Jedi Order]] received over thirty three kybucks during the time period from before the year [[115 BBY]]<ref name="Jedi Path">[[The Jedi Path: A Manual for Students of the Force (real-life book)|''The Jedi Path: A Manual for Students of the Force'']]</ref> until [[19 BBY/Legends|19 BBY]].

While patrolling on [[Korriban/Legends|Korriban]], one of Yoda's kybucks was attacked and killed by an enraged [[Tuk'ata/Legends|tuk'ata]]. In approximately [[32 BBY/Legends|32 BBY]], Yoda recorded this event in [[Sorzus Syn]]'s chronicle and noted that he had not yet replaced it.<ref name="Book of Sith - Yoda's note">''[[Book of Sith: Secrets from the Dark Side]]''</ref>

By 19 BBY, however, Yoda had a [[Yoda's kybuck|new kybuck]], received as a gift as a token of gratitude for saving the life of a Woolwarricca [[Prince/Legends|princess]]. The creature would assist the Jedi during the [[Battle of Coruscant/Legends|Battle of Coruscant]].

A colony of kybucks was established on [[Felucia/Legends|Felucia]] during the [[Battle of Felucia (Outer Rim Sieges)/Legends|battle there]] by [[Confederacy of Independent Systems/Legends|Confederate]] [[Mercenary/Legends|mercenaries]], including [[Vazus Mandrake]], who tended to the creatures after the war's end.

[[File:Kybuck.jpg|thumb|180px|Yoda's kybuck]]

==Behind the scenes==
The kybuck was given an action figure along with Yoda in the fifth wave of [[Hasbro]]'s ''[[Star Wars: 30th Anniversary Collection]]''. This pack was re-released in the ''[[Star Wars: The Legacy Collection]]'' line.
